data.name: Spontaneous Symbology
data.description: Your knowledge of the secret history of the world has unveiled the mysterious symbols that govern reality. You can cast any RsymbolS spell using a spell slot of the appropriate level, even if the spell is not on your list of spellUs known. A symbol spell is any spell with the word RsymbolS in its name.
